name: Alex's Caves
description: Alex's Caves hides six huge biomes underground.

pages.title: Alex's Caves
pages.text: **Alex's Caves** hides six huge biomes underground. Each has its own creatures, blocks and hazards. They are rare, so the mod gives you a way to locate them.

The six: **Magnetic Caves**, **Primordial Caves** (dinosaurs, minus the rideable Subterranodon), **Toxic Caves** (acid and uranium), **Abyssal Chasm** (a deep water trench), **Forlorn Hollows** and **Candy Cavity**.

pages.title: Spelunkery Table
pages.text: Where Cave Tablets are studied. Place a tablet in the slot to begin research.

pages.title: Cave Biome Map
pages.text: A map pointing to the nearest cave biome of a type. If none is near, travel far away and try again.

Toxic Caves are the Create-connected one. Acid and Purple Soda are marked in Create's own data as **bottomless** fluids, like water and lava, so a hose pulley can draw them without running dry. See [#](2E5AAC)[Fluids](entry://create_basics/fluids)[#]().

pages.title: Uranium Rod
pages.text: Alex's Caves has its own uranium and a Nuclear Furnace. It is separate content from Create Nuclear, so check JEI before mixing them.

Magnetic Caves add Magnetic Levitation Rail and Neodymium nodes. The Abyssal Chasm is a deep water trench under the ocean, best reached in a [#](2E5AAC)[Deep Seas](entry://ocean/submarines)[#]() submarine.

pages.title: Turned off here
pages.text: Two Alex's Caves rides skip the vehicle game, so they are off. The flying **Subterranodon** never spawns. The **Hullbreaker** no longer drops the Enigmatic Engine, so you can't build its small Submarine. Wrecked ones in the chasm ruins can still be fixed. See [#](2E5AAC)[Getting Around](entry://transport/getting_around)[#]().
Alex's Caves sulfur dust is not its own item here. Its recipes (Slam, Spelunkie, Polymer Plate, gunpowder) use TFMG's sulfur dust, and leftover Alex's dust converts 1:1 in a crafting grid.
